proposal: Confidential pre-emergency reserve-pool feasibility for smaller utilities with owner-held assets: reveal one jointly authorized feasibility bit over a fixed simultaneous-failure scenario set, without centralizing private inventory/eligibility/retention data.
provenance: Root-proposed synthesis after earlier searches and independent rejection; not an unseen initial answer, not a fresh blinded candidate, and not evidence of expert-search superiority.
not_admitted_claims: World-first private resource matching or coupled feasibility
Privacy established as the dominant small-utility participation barrier
Validated utility demand, binding spare rights, insurance or physical dispatch
Ordinary-versus-expert Operational Alpha or a graph-specific moat
central_judgment: This can earn a bounded constructed-opportunity experiment because it defines a different information product: an exact joint feasibility answer under an explicit no-central-disclosure charter, before participants agree to disclose or commit assets. The construction must actually run multiparty computation and preserve coupled obligations. Merely wrapping a familiar solver or relabeling a report does not satisfy that claim. The novelty is a scoped application/arrangement hypothesis, not the established private-computation principle.

strongest_prior_art_collisions.title: A Privacy-Preserving Method to Optimize Distributed Resource Allocation
strongest_prior_art_collisions.finding: The primary journal abstract already describes global resource allocation subject to private individual constraints, existence of feasible disaggregation, secure multiparty computation and energy-resource examples. This is a stronger conceptual collision than pairwise inventory matching.
strongest_prior_art_collisions.scope: Primary publisher-indexed abstract retrieved; direct DOI follow-up timed out. No claim to have inspected the full proof.

strongest_prior_art_collisions.title: Prime Match: A Privacy-Preserving Inventory Matching System
strongest_prior_art_collisions.finding: Privacy-preserving financial inventory matching already runs in production according to its authors. The paper reports malicious security, a stronger adversary setting than the proposed passive MPyC prototype.
strongest_prior_art_collisions.scope: Direct primary conference page; financial matching is not claimed to be identical utility reserve feasibility.

strongest_prior_art_collisions.title: Privacy Preserving Coordinated Inventory Replenishment Policies in a Multi-Stage Supply Chain
strongest_prior_art_collisions.finding: A 2011 primary paper already applies MPC to coordinated inventory policies while avoiding disclosure of proprietary inputs. Confidential inventory coordination is not newly invented here.
strongest_prior_art_collisions.scope: Direct primary publisher abstract; not an exact transformer-reserve product.

incumbent_boundary.verified_scope: SPAREConnect provides decentralized contacts, has no central asset database, creates no binding duty to reveal information or supply equipment, and describes requests during emergencies or other nonroutine failures.
incumbent_boundary.implication: The proposed pre-emergency coupled feasibility bit is distinguishable from its documented contact service. Do not describe SpareConnect as centrally exposing inventory; it already avoids a central asset database.

incumbent_boundary.verified_scope: Existing dedicated reserve inventory and preplanned delivery offer dependable shared access.
incumbent_boundary.implication: Compare with this competent procurement alternative. The proposed service uses existing owner-held assets under private retention conditions; it does not create Grid Assurance-equivalent availability or logistics.

admission_conditions_for_experiment.condition: Freeze the useful output and formal obligations before confirmation.
admission_conditions_for_experiment.detail: For every publicly specified scenario, require existence of a simultaneous allocation satisfying all recipient requirements, whole-asset exclusivity/capacity, private eligibility, scenario availability, deadlines and private owner-retention rules. This is quantified feasibility over a finite declared set, not a reservation or dispatch promise. Reject empty/ill-defined scenario sets and unsupported data rather than gaining vacuous acceptance.

admission_conditions_for_experiment.condition: Execute the privacy mechanism, with the claimed trust boundary accurately labeled.
admission_conditions_for_experiment.detail: Run at least three logically separate parties with each application process reading only its own private input. MPyC documents Shamir-based security against passive corruption of less than half the parties. A single-host synthetic run demonstrates functioning software, not independent organizations, resistance to malicious input/protocol deviation, or private-channel deployment security.

Reveal only the authorized aggregate feasibility bit and declared public metadata. The bit itself can imply sensitive facts, especially with side information; do not claim zero disclosure. Freeze or pad problem dimensions and iteration shape if counts are private. Do not publish unsalted hashes of small secret input vectors and call them hiding commitments.

admission_conditions_for_experiment.condition: Bound repeated-query disclosure and preserve authority.
admission_conditions_for_experiment.detail: Bind authorization to pool, protocol, scenario-set and input-version scope. One authorized epoch must not silently permit changed demands or adaptive subset queries. Prevent replay/new-query substitution in the application fixture, while acknowledging this is not a malicious-secure distributed governance proof. No per-scenario failure mask or hidden assignment may leak through logging or error messages.

admission_conditions_for_experiment.condition: Give competent controls the same formulation and input facts.
admission_conditions_for_experiment.detail: Central full-information solver must agree exactly but violates the stipulated no-central-disclosure requirement; label that charter difference. Bilateral existence is only a diagnostic weak control and must face a shared-spare simultaneous-claim counterexample. Ordinary identical MPC implementation is the main competent control and may tie exactly. Do not convert that tie into numerical Alpha.

admission_conditions_for_experiment.condition: Preserve the gap between private calculation and true real-world inputs.
admission_conditions_for_experiment.detail: MPC does not validate inventory truth, physical compatibility, hidden liens, transport access or owner willingness. Synthetic/private eligibility bits are supplied inputs. Actual qualification, selective disclosure and binding commitments belong to a separate authorized stage.

admission_conditions_for_experiment.condition: Keep the paid scope and complete economics attached to this information product.
admission_conditions_for_experiment.detail: Price a confidential pre-feasibility computation/assembly service, with value from a defined go/no-go decision, rather than selling guaranteed reserve access. Include party onboarding and input preparation only where required by the supported workflow, secure execution/communications, validation, recovery, security maintenance, participant coordination and any residual expert work. Compare a competent human/MPC integrator, trusted-NDA alternatives for buyers who permit them, and existing reserve procurement. Use no-privacy-premium and no-demand scenarios.

minimum_decisive_construction.technical: A small exact finite system with real MPyC execution, deterministic independent central oracle, fresh feasible and infeasible instances, correlated failures, owner-retention conflicts, unknown eligibility and an explicit bilateral-overpromise example. Test output equality and authorized-output/log boundaries; record cost/latency/communication within the chosen envelope.
minimum_decisive_construction.commercial: A separately labeled finite scenario in which the buyers value the one-bit decision and decline central disclosure, with price-dependent participation and full provider/participant costs. Include cases where ordinary disclosure, NDA coordination, dedicated reserves or no purchase dominate.
strong_falsifiers: Changed-scope query admitted under old authority
No simultaneous feasible allocation despite bilateral matches
Complete service and participant costs exceed decision value
Target buyers permit ordinary centralized analysis or do not value a feasibility-only output
Comparable incumbent/integrator already supplies the same output more cheaply
minimum_decisive_construction.success_claim_if_passed: An executed application of established privacy-preserving computation produces correct scoped joint-feasibility answers without releasing inputs beyond the declared function/public-metadata leakage, under a passive-honest-majority model; modeled commercial viability remains conditional.
minimum_decisive_construction.successor_inheritance: The domain schema, exact finite function, tested constraint cases, source-linked interpretation, query-authority rules, failure counterexamples and measured execution envelope. Recheck each new pool and regrant every new scope.

what_has_changed_now: Available agent coding/reasoning and maintained MPC software make rapid application construction plausible. The search establishes that the core computational principle predates current frontier agents. Any claim that agent assistance makes this segment newly economical needs measured assembly effort or explicit uncertainty ranges, not a novelty inference from successful execution.
